notes: Each eval runs the skill through its Implement+verify stage only (steps 1-3); review/ship stages are out of scope for the harness. Baseline = pre-TDD snapshot of the skill. Discriminating behavior: test-first for behavior-changing findings, no fake test for structure-only ones.

evals.name: behavior-changing-bug
evals.prompt: Address the next finding in reports/findings.md.
evals.expected_output: Skill classifies the finding behavior-changing, writes a test asserting applyDiscount(100,20)===80 that FAILS before the code fix (red), then divides rate by 100 so it passes (green). Existing zero-discount test stays green. node --test passes.

evals.name: structure-only-dup-delete
evals.prompt: Address the next finding in reports/findings.md.
evals.expected_output: Skill classifies the finding structure-only, deletes formatFullName, repoints greet.js at formatName, and relies on the existing suite (no new fake test added). node --test passes.

evals.name: refactor-flavored-behavior-change
evals.prompt: Address the next finding in reports/findings.md.
evals.expected_output: Despite the DRY/refactor phrasing, skill recognizes the consolidation changes the admin path's behavior (gains a length cap), classifies it behavior-changing, and writes a test pinning that the shared validator rejects >20-char usernames before consolidating. node --test passes.
